blue.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The id of the float [Output Component](https://esphome.io/components/output/) to use for the blue channel.

*See also: [RGBW Light](https://esphome.io/components/light/rgbw#configuration-variables)*

color_interlock.docs:
**boolean**: When enabled, this will prevent white leds being on at the same time as RGB leds. See [Color Interlock](https://esphome.io/components/light/rgbw#color-interlock) for more information. Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [RGBW Light](https://esphome.io/components/light/rgbw#configuration-variables)*
